feature_matrix.method: Exploratory centered circular 5-observed-session block bootstrap, 2000 draws, seed 20261021; missing/non-trade days retained in resampling. Global Holm over all 40 contrasts (4 strategies x 5 features/contrasts x 2 outcomes). Untestable p=1 retained. Approximate observational inference, not causal or independent validation.
feature_matrix.selection: No fitted cutoffs. Prior-location pairs; continuous RVOL and overnight/ATR Spearman. Overnight compressed<0.5 and expanded>1.2 are descriptive existing-regime groups only. MFE is the frozen minute-bar bound through exit, not tick-exact.

availability.ticks: UNAVAILABLE: raw source contains OHLCV only; no trade count. All relative-ticks/intensity outputs null.
availability.opening_context: 09:30 open is known at 09:30; masked for earlier/equal-time entries.
availability.opening_volume: First 15 completed 1m bars known at 09:45. RVOL uses previous 14 active sessions only; masked for earlier trades.
availability.distance: Signed distance from completed signal close to current-basis PDH/PDL, not unknown next-open entry price.
availability.daily_export: Timestamped feature snapshots, NOT a claim every field was known before every trade.

limitations: No real ticks, order book or trade-level VWAP.
Panama changes ATR-based risk/targets even on existing eligible dates; this is not merely appending lost trades.
Same-clock signal-volume histories still contract-native; quality/prefix gates unchanged. Zero ATR loss is not a guarantee all calendar days become trade eligible.
Spreads use vendor 15:59 minute closes, not official settlement; identical-clock prices may be asynchronous last trades.
Entire dataset already observed: all vNext comparisons exploratory; no promotion or strategy selection.
Initial history and holiday/incomplete-session exclusions remain. Period is Dec30 plus Jan-Sep, not ten complete months.
